changes.description: Integrated OpenAlex and Semantic Scholar as new data sources for research articles.
Enhanced the observability dashboard with Gantt-style waterfall visualizations and pipeline stage cards.
Introduced article sharing capabilities and a guest mode for easier collaboration.
Fixed an issue where line charts failed to render correctly when data contained intermittent null values.
Added internationalization support for trace table columns and log dialogs.
Introduced a global query settings panel for the monitoring dashboard.
Improved data visibility by adding article titles and original source information to trace tables.
Added a contact email option to the application for user support.
Initial release: RSS, ArXiv, and blog article scraping pipeline
Multi-provider LLM analysis with automatic fallback (Gemini, Claude, OpenRouter)
Admin panel for managing topics, scraper sources, and users
Automatic translation of analyses, tags, and tag groups into configured languages
Knowledge graph visualization with group and article nodes
Telegram notifications on pipeline completion with per-run stats
OpenTelemetry metrics and structured Loki logging across all pipeline stages
GeoIP-based automatic language detection for frontend visitors
